body.statement: For every well-typed explicit instance \(I\), \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}(I)\) terminates and returns a verified circuit \(C\), a verifier-accepted \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), or an exact obstruction \(O\); malformed input alone returns \(\mathsf{invalid}\).  On a circuit branch, for every \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\) with \(\mathcal F_+(p)\ne\varnothing\) and every \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\), \(C(p)=H(\theta)/K(\theta)\).  For exact numerical input, \(\operatorname{Eval}\) returns \(\mathsf{infeasible}\) exactly when \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\varnothing\), and returns \(\mathsf{undefined\mbox{-}zero\mbox{-}denominator}\) exactly when \(\mathcal F_0(p)\ne\varnothing\) but \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\).  On a certificate branch, both decoded models belong to \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\), have the declared alphabets and source incidence, agree on every supplied complete regime law, have positive denominators, and have unequal values of \(q\).  Thus every positive or negative output is sound; no claim is made here that \(O\) is impossible or that the procedure is complete.
body.justification: The formula-or-verifiable-same-class-countermodel dichotomy is the completeness contract absent from cyclic Layer-3 identification.
body.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Algorithms 1--2 and Theorems 5--6, proves this contract for recursive acyclic SCMs; ForreMooij2020, Theorem 9.10 and Remark 9.11, gives sound cyclic interventional identification without completeness.
body.consumer: The cfid package gains feedback-capable symbolic output or a replayable failure certificate with exact domain statuses.
body.proof_tex:
For a well-typed instance, the ordered validation in \(\text{def:algorithm-handle}\) succeeds because every supplied table and polynomial has already been checked against the decoder.  At every structural step one pending item is replaced only by items having strictly smaller five-tuple measure.  The multiset extension is well founded: map a tuple \((w,d,a,e,h)\) to the ordinal \(\omega^4w+\omega^3d+\omega^2a+\omega e+h\), and map a finite multiset to the natural sum of \(\omega\) raised to these ranks.  Replacing one element by finitely many lower-ranked elements strictly decreases this ordinal.  Each CAD or Gr\"obner terminal has a finite ordered worklist and consumes its least item.  Hence all branches terminate and, by the final-output clause of \(\text{def:algorithm-handle}\), end in \(C\), \((\Gamma,\mathcal M^-,\mathcal M^+)\), or \(O\).

Suppose a circuit \(C=N/D\) is emitted.  The two exact universal checks in \(\text{def:source-terminal-elimination}\) have found no legal \(\theta\) with \(K(\theta)>0\) for which either
\[
 D(\Phi(\theta))H(\theta)-N(\Phi(\theta))K(\theta)\ne0
 \quad\text{or}\quad D(\Phi(\theta))=0.
\]
Formula composition through the recursion consists only of finite sums, products, cancellations already justified by a positive conditioning factor, and substitution of verified terminal expressions.  Induction backward along the finite trace therefore gives the same two identities for the global \(\Phi,H,K\).  If \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{feas}}\), \(\theta\in\mathcal F_+(p)\), then \(\Phi(\theta)=p\), \(K(\theta)>0\), and \(D(p)\ne0\); consequently
\[
 C(p)=\frac{N(p)}{D(p)}=\frac{H(\theta)}{K(\theta)}.
\]
This proves sound identification without asserting that the circuit branch is reached whenever the ratio is fiber-constant.

The two status statements follow immediately from the ordered tests in \(\text{def:evaluation-semantics}\): the first is the exact emptiness test for \(\mathcal F_0(p)\), and, conditional on nonemptiness, the second is the exact emptiness test for \(\mathcal F_+(p)\).  No division is attempted on either status branch.

Finally suppose a certificate is emitted and accepted by \(\mathsf{Verify}\).  By \(\text{def:certificate-verifier}\), its algebraic coordinates satisfy the source-simplex signs exactly, retain separate labeled source blocks, decode only legal profiles, and pass every subset unique-solution check.  Thus both decoded models lie in \(\mathfrak M_{sc}(G,\operatorname{inc},\mathcal X)\).  The verifier establishes \(\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+)\), and \(\text{lem:boundary-interface-gluing}\) preserves these equalities through every stored exterior interface.  Hence all supplied laws agree.  It also establishes \(K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0\) and \(\Delta_q\ne0\), so the displayed cross-product calculation in that lemma proves unequal conditional targets.  This proves soundness of the negative output.  The argument deliberately does not eliminate \(O\); that is precisely the unresolved content of \(\text{oeq:sparse-terminal-descent}\).
